title: JA Vega wp7: the back-to-top button, footer social marks, log-in fields, project card intros, drawer back row and text-field focus match the source
steps: S1: A WordPress site running the wp-ja-vega theme under test (local stand from the quickstart pack) and the Joomla source (local stand from quickstart/ja-vega/j6, web fonts loaded, a missing page answers 404).

S2: From the TCH checkout run: node vendor/wordpress/tracy-wordpress-theme/skills/tracy-wordpress-theme/scripts/visual/site-sweep.mjs --site <site> --source <source> --run-root tasks/ja-vega-wp7 --zip <theme.zip> --out <dir>
S5: Read the summary table and the final line of each command.
expect: site-sweep: overflow, scheme, background, header and chips all report 0 defects and 0 not-measured over 34 routes x 6 widths x light and dark.

measure118: back-to-top-button (66 cases) and footer-social-icons (66 cases) show the source's blue square with a white chevron and the four Font Awesome marks at the same boxes, colours and extent; login-form-fields: username and password are required, the username has the focus on load, the form is 402 x 352; text-field-focus: a focused field has the source's border and no ring; project-card-excerpts: the three project pages print the source's 100-character intro ending in '...'; drawer-back-row-case and drawer-open-strip: the back row is set in capitals and the pushed menu button and close cross sit where the source's do.
evidence: Measures of 05/10/2026 against the local Joomla source: on 1.1.7 the sweep passes 5/5 and sees none of the defects, the seven new checks all fail (fix-measure baseline 6/13); on 1.1.8 all 13 checks pass, 0 not measured (fix-measure.json 13/13, bound to wp-ja-vega-1.1.8.zip 3bbe84d7)
fence: Browser-measured behaviour of the shipped theme against the source; the tool exits non-zero on a defect, and a check that examined nothing fails
